• ‘Tamayaz Points’ or ‘Points’ means the loyalty currency that may be earned and redeemed by a Cardmember pursuant to the Tamayaz Rewards Programme Rules and, where applicable, these Liv Tamayaz Mastercard Credit Card Special Features, Benefit Terms & Conditions.

• Gold Tamayaz members will be eligible for a higher redemption rate for points earned on the Tamayaz Credit Cards in comparison to Silver Tamayaz members, only available at Union Cooperative stores and e-commerce purchases. Gold membership is only available to Union Cooperative shareholders.
You can apply for the card via the Liv X mobile app or from the Liv website. Select your preferred card type and let us guide you toward your instantly issued and approved credit card.
• Both salaried and self-employed customers can apply for the card.

Cashback earned is automatically converted to Tamayaz Points at the end of every billing cycle. You can redeem these points your next bill at Union Coop store or online - it is like getting free groceries just for using your card.
